sub_unapproved_included.fail: Subcontractor pay application {pay_app} is included in this claim while it is {status}, so the amount billed to the owner has not been approved for payment
sub_unapproved_included.suggestion: Approve the pay application, or exclude it from this claim until it is approved

sub_waiver_missing.fail_amount: Subcontractor pay application {pay_app} nets {net}, but the lien waivers on file for it cover only {covered}
sub_waiver_missing.fail_through_date: The lien waiver for subcontractor pay application {pay_app} runs through {through_date}, which is before the pay application's period end of {period_end}
sub_waiver_missing.suggestion: Collect a lien waiver covering the full net amount through the end of the period, or exclude the pay application from this claim

sub_prior_unconditional_missing.fail: Subcontractor pay application {pay_app} was paid on an earlier claim, but no unconditional lien waiver on file runs through its period end of {period_end}
sub_prior_unconditional_missing.suggestion: Collect the unconditional lien waiver for the payment already made and record the date it runs through

sub_line_unmapped.fail_none: A line of subcontractor pay application {pay_app} for work package {package}, approved at {amount}, is not linked to any line of this contract's schedule of values
sub_line_unmapped.fail_foreign_line: A line of subcontractor pay application {pay_app} for work package {package}, approved at {amount}, is linked to a line of a different contract
sub_line_unmapped.fail_parent_line: A line of subcontractor pay application {pay_app} for work package {package}, approved at {amount}, is linked to a grouping line, which is not billed directly
sub_line_unmapped.suggestion: Link the work package, or this pay application line, to a billable line of this contract's schedule of values

sub_exceeds_gc_line.fail: Subcontract amounts approved to date on line {line} total {approved}, above its scheduled value of {scheduled}
sub_exceeds_gc_line.suggestion: Check the subcontract approvals on this line, or add a change order that raises its scheduled value

sub_certificate_lapsed.fail_missing: {subcontractor} has no {document} on file as of {as_of}, the end of this claim's period
sub_certificate_lapsed.fail_expired: {subcontractor}'s {document} was no longer valid on {as_of}, the end of this claim's period
sub_certificate_lapsed.fail_revoked: {subcontractor}'s {document} was revoked and was not valid on {as_of}, the end of this claim's period
sub_certificate_lapsed.suggestion: Obtain a current certificate from the subcontractor, or exclude their pay applications from this claim

sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_missing: {subcontractor} was paid on {paid_on} for pay application {pay_app} with no {document} on file. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_expired: {subcontractor} was paid on {paid_on} for pay application {pay_app}, but their {document} had run out on {lapsed_on}. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_revoked: {subcontractor} was paid on {paid_on} for pay application {pay_app}, but their {document} had been revoked. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_undated: Pay application {pay_app} of {subcontractor} is marked paid but carries no payment date, so whether the {document} covered the payment cannot be checked. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_pending: Pay application {pay_app} of {subcontractor} is not paid yet. The {document} counts on the day it is paid, not at the end of the period, and the one on file is valid until {valid_until}. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_pending_open: Pay application {pay_app} of {subcontractor} is not paid yet. The {document} counts on the day it is paid, not at the end of the period; the one on file has no end date. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.fail_pending_invalid: Pay application {pay_app} of {subcontractor} is not paid yet, and there is no valid {document} on file that a payment after the period end could fall within. {withholding}
sub_certificate_payment_date.suggestion: Check that the certificate is valid on the day you pay, and get a current one from the subcontractor if it is not. The tax is not deducted here: where a payment falls outside a valid certificate, making and reporting the deduction is up to you.

withholding.gross_limit: Without it, {rate}% of the payment, VAT included, has to be withheld and paid to the tax office, unless everything paid to this subcontractor in the calendar year stays within {limit} ({reference}).
withholding.gross: Without it, {rate}% of the payment, VAT included, has to be withheld and paid to the tax office ({reference}).
withholding.net_limit: Without it, {rate}% of the payment, VAT excluded, has to be withheld and paid to the tax office, unless everything paid to this subcontractor in the calendar year stays within {limit} ({reference}).
withholding.net: Without it, {rate}% of the payment, VAT excluded, has to be withheld and paid to the tax office ({reference}).
withholding.unknown: Without it, the payment may be subject to tax withholding.
